h1: Custom Henley Products for Your Team
metaDescription: Shop custom henley products for your team. Perfect for uniforms or giveaways. Bulk pricing available.
introHtml: Henley necklines add a rugged, polished look to uniforms and promotional apparel. Unlike standard crewnecks, the button placket and collar offer a versatile style that works under jackets or on its own. Perfect for construction crews, hospitality staff, or outdoor event teams who want a professional appearance with room to move. Decorate with embroidery or screen printing for lasting brand visibility.
heroAltText: Custom henley products with button placket and collar, ideal for team uniforms
